id.description: World id: bundle folder public/worlds/<id>/ and cache folder.

origin.description: World (0, 0): the local transverse Mercator's central point.

dem.description: Heightfield source. Without "source" the bake uses aws-terrain-tiles (the default, needs "zoom").

zoom.description: Slippy-map zoom of the terrarium PNGs (13 ≈ 13 m pixels at 43°N).

oneOf.title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (1 arc-second COGs), opt-in

osmDate.description: Overpass attic date (ISO 8601) every OSM query is pinned to.

routes.description: Scenic route ids from src/lib/scenicRoutes.ts that lie inside the world.

routesOutside.description: Nearby route ids left out, with the reason.

host.description: Publish the bundle off-repo: baked to tools/worldbake/remote/<id>/ (only manifest.json is committed), uploaded by publish.mjs to worlds/<id>/<hash>/ in the public R2 bucket, loaded from the remote worlds base URL and kept in the Cache API. Absent: shipped in public/worlds/<id>/. Not part of generator.recipeSha256.

coast.description: A world on the sea (tools/worldbake/coast.mjs): fetch the coast layer, build the sea from the natural=coastline ways (water areas of kind `sea`, terrain levelled to sea level under them) and natural=beach/sand areas as landcover kind `beach`.

buildingSimplifyM.description: Simplify building footprints at this tolerance, metres (default 0.3). For dense metro worlds whose OSM footprints are surveyed to the corner (Los Angeles County's import: 9.6 vertices a building): 1 m halves their triangles, so the buildings in view fit the fps budget.

flatLakes.description: Level the terrain under every OSM lake and pond (tools/worldbake/flatLakes.mjs): for lakes newer than the DEM, which still carries the land they were dug from.

bridges.description: Build bridges as structures (tools/worldbake/bridges.mjs): deck heights from the abutments with headroom over every route passing under, ridden decks not carved into the ground, ground kept under every deck, piers. Writes the bridges layer.

bareGround.description: Swap an open bare-earth DTM in along the routes before the route fit (tools/worldbake/bareGround.mjs). GLO-30 is a surface model, so under a forest the routes would ride the canopy. Without it the bake is unchanged.

tiles.description: The dated release of every 1° tile the corridor touches (historical/<tile>/USGS_13_<tile>_<release>.tif), e.g. { "n42w082": "20230911" }.

corridorM.description: Full DTM within this many metres of a route (default 150).

blendM.description: Then a smoothstep back to the surface model over this many metres (default 300).

year.description: The swissALTI3D release (STAC item year) every corridor tile is read from, e.g. 2022.

corridorM.description: Full DTM within this many metres of a route (default 150).

blendM.description: Then a smoothstep back to the surface model over this many metres (default 300).

routeCredits.description: Add one manifest credit per route linking the OSM relation or OSRM bike query its geometry came from (scripts/scenicRouteSources.mjs).

embankment.description: Bare-ground worlds: where the fitted route stands more than maxM over the ground at the route and over all ground out to acrossM on both sides (and is not on or within 20 m of a mapped bridge or tunnel), lower it to maxM over the ground, easing back over rampM along the route (snapRoutes.mjs embankmentLowering). Needs bareGround.

corridor.description: Woodland within m of a route keeps the share keep first; the rest of the world shares what is left of maxInstances (buildVectors.mjs buildVegetation).

validation.description: Blueprint §P1.3 v2 terrain accuracy check (tools/worldbake/p13Criterion.mjs, docs/worlds/WORLD-FORMAT.md "Terrain accuracy check"). The author sets sample_seed and, optionally, the mountain override; the bake writes every other field back on each validated bake, and a committed recipe must carry all of them.

sample_seed.description: Seed of the 50 sample points (author input).

terrain_class_override.description: Force the class up to mountain (author input). A recipe may never force standard.

terrain_class_override_reason.description: Why the override is needed (author input, required with the override).
